[[File:TempleClass-AoRCR.png|thumb|right|200px|A ''Temple''-class heavy freighter]]
The '''''Temple''-class heavy freighter''' was a type of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] produced by the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. Twelve ''Temple''-class heavy [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]], along with their escort [[Starship/Legends|starships]], made up the secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] known as the [[Perlemian Haul]].<ref name="PH">{{FFG|story=Perlemian Haul (adventure)|book=Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>
